name: @vanaheimr/cose
author: GraphDefined GmbH <achim.friedland@graphdefined.com>
description: CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (RFC 9052) in TypeScript, on top of the Metrological CBOR codec — the TypeScript counterpart of Vanaheimr Styx's Illias/COSE.
comment: The CBOR codec is reached through src/cbor.ts alone, and currently as a sibling checkout of MetrologicalCBOR.TS rather than as a dependency, because @vanaheimr/metrological-cbor is not published yet. Signing from source is also what the conformance suite needs. When that package ships, src/cbor.ts gains an ordinary import and this file a dependency.
